app_info.subtitle: Continuity for AI agents
app_info.description: Organizational continuity for AI agents. Make AI work resumable, reviewable, and provable across agents. The task outlives the chat: OrgX lets the next agent continue from the decisions, artifacts, approvals, owners, and proof the last agent left behind. Users can search company context, inspect initiatives, review pending decisions, scaffold work, delegate agent tasks, and view interactive widgets for status and follow-up actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Not read-only: it persists the selected workspace and session continuity when context changes, while leaving business records unchanged.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches OrgX memory and entities and returns matching results without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Hydrates one OrgX entity and related context without modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes recommendations and brief signals from existing OrgX data without writing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates private OrgX entities, so it changes workspace state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Initiative writes can publish a publicly visible live link outside the private OrgX workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Update mode overwrites supplied fields and those changes may not be automatically recoverable.

justifications.read_only_justification: Attaches proof or artifact metadata to existing OrgX entities, so it changes workspace state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to private OrgX workspace records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds artifact context but does not delete or overwrite existing records irreversibly.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs lifecycle actions such as validation, completion, pause, or delete, so it can change OrgX state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Launch and resume actions can dispatch agent work that operates in connected systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can run delete or irreversible lifecycle actions depending on the requested action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Pauses, resumes, retries, or cancels running OrgX work and therefore changes execution state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Resume and retry can redispatch descendant agents that may act in connected third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Controls reversible runtime state and cancels active work without deleting durable OrgX records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Starts, edits, improves, or completes tracked OrgX plan sessions, so it can write session state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to private OrgX planning state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes planning records but does not delete records or perform irreversible external actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can guard, classify, spawn, or hand off specialist agent work, so it may create private OrgX agent work.
justifications.open_world_justification: Spawn and handoff modes may initiate agent work that uses connected third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Spawn and handoff modes can dispatch work that is not automatically reversible after execution begins.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can create, approve, reject, or remember decisions, so it changes decision state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Approve mode can resume or continue agent work that operates in connected systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Approval or rejection can irreversibly resolve a pending decision; approval may also resume execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Submits durable proof, attribution, quality, or outcome receipts, so it writes OrgX state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to private OrgX workspace records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds receipt records but does not delete records or perform irreversible external actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Approves a pending decision and changes its state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Approval can resume or continue agent work that operates in connected systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Approval irreversibly resolves a pending decision and may resume execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Rejects or requests changes on a pending decision and changes its state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to private OrgX decision records.
justifications.destructive_justification: Rejection can irreversibly resolve or redirect a pending decision.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves agent activity and status without modifying OrgX records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves initiative health, blockers, milestones, and activity without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Default launch mode creates an OrgX initiative hierarchy and starts assigned agents.
justifications.open_world_justification: Launch mode dispatches agent work, and external_sync can create projects or tasks in connected work trackers such as Linear.
justifications.destructive_justification: Default launch mode starts agent execution and optional external synchronization may not be automatically reversible.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reassigns task ownership and can spawn a new agent run.
justifications.open_world_justification: May initiate work that uses connected systems outside the immediate ChatGPT conversation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can dispatch or reassign work in a way that is not automatically reversible after execution begins.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can approve or reject agent approval items, so it changes approval state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Approve mode can resume or continue agent work that operates in connected systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Approval or rejection can irreversibly resolve agent work; approval may also resume execution.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the next matching artifact and renders it for review without changing review state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private OrgX artifact records and does not publish to third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, approve, reject, or otherwise modify the artifact.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves morning brief signals and value summaries without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves decision chronology, artifacts, PR receipts, priorities, goals, velocity, and reporting gaps without modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only on private OrgX workspace data for the authenticated user.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Checks configured execution credentials and readiness without dispatching work or modifying OrgX records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads private OrgX workspace configuration and does not publish to external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not dispatch, delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change workspace state.

test_cases.description: Bootstrap the connected OrgX workspace and session guidance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start OrgX and show my workspace context.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected workspace context, granted scopes, and safe next-step guidance without exposing access tokens, raw session IDs, or secrets.

test_cases.description: List the deterministic seeded decisions awaiting approval.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the pending decisions that need approval today.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the three seeded pending decisions with title, status, urgency or priority, and enough context to approve or reject.

test_cases.description: Search memory for a seeded initiative decision.
test_cases.user_prompt: What did we decide about Search Copilot readiness?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns prior decision and memory context for Search Copilot Readiness with relevant artifact or entity references.

test_cases.description: Render initiative health for a seeded initiative.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the pulse for the Search Copilot Readiness initiative.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the seeded initiative health, blockers if present, milestone/task summary, and the initiative-pulse widget.

test_cases.description: Render the current agent status widget.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me what the OrgX agents are doing right now.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the seeded agent roster or active and idle agent state, and renders the agent-status widget without changing workspace state.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar lookup is outside OrgX workflows.
